Maya Chen: Heads-up — PR #8902 (db-migration-hotpatch) needs 2x LGTM before tonight's cutover at 21:00 UTC. Can people give quick eyes? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8902
release-bot: Reminder: Cutover window opens in 90m. Merge hold will be enforced at T-15m. Required approvals: 2 reviewers.
Theo Alvarez: I can review now. quick q — does this change any PKs or require a coordinated lock?
Priya Desai: No PK changes. Ran the migration on staging earlier today (2026-03-16T03:10Z). Smoke stack passed. Snippet from logs: `migration: applied 202603160310 ok`
Jared Kim: I can only give LGTM after a prod-canary smoke run. I can kick that off at 20:05 UTC. @Maya can you queue the canary?
Maya Chen: queued canary at 20:04 UTC — command: `./infra/canary-run --pr 8902 --env canary`
release-bot: Canary job started for PR 8902 (job id: cb-4421).
release-bot: Canary passed at 20:09 UTC — basic latency and error budget checks OK.
Theo Alvarez: quick code note: fixed a stray debug log in `db/migrate.go` and pushed a tiny follow-up — nothing functional. LGTM from me after that.
Priya Desai: Looked through the diffs, retention config tweak is fine. LGTM.
Jared Kim: Running post-merge smoke plan on canary-prod at 21:03 UTC and will watch for query latency/regression. If I see anything sketchy I'll flag rollback.
Maya Chen: Great — that's 2x LGTM. Plan: merge at T-10m unless rollback triggered earlier. Rollback plan: revert PR + redeploy previous image; oncall to run `scripts/rollback.sh --to-prev`.
Jared Kim: One ask — leave the new flag off by default for 30m post-merge, then we can toggle if clean.
Maya Chen: Agree. I'll merge and keep flag disabled.
release-bot: Merge completed at 4987654385 — commit `abcd1234`. Auto-backout window: 10m (4987654395).
Maya Chen: Merged — thanks everyone. I'll monitor logs and post a short summary in #incidents if anything pops. :thumbsup:
Jared Kim: Watching now. Will post if I see regressions.
Theo Alvarez: Thanks — nice quick turnaround.
Priya Desai: :rocket:
